_source: Ours. The book prices jobs by what they are, and leaves who gets offered what to the GM. These tiers make that the engine's: a crew nobody has heard of gets street work, and better-paid work is also more dangerous work, because pay that climbs while danger stays flat is eurobucks that only go up.

_rules.tier: The highest tier whose Reputation and jobs-finished requirements are both met.
_rules.fixer: A fixer who has gone cold on you (disposition below coldBelow) puts you up for one tier less than you have earned.
_rules.fit: A job fits a tier when its per-head fee and its force size are both the tier's. Overwhelming forces are never generated, so no tier asks for one.
_rules.hostile: An employer whose faction is hostile to you does not hire you, whatever your tier.
